text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To help her get used to real races, she was training in her
Racing Gear today. As I took another good look at her...
choice_data_list: Hmm...? Somehow, this feels strangely nostalgic...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As if you've known it since long ago...?
Even though this outfit is something
I made after enrolling in the academy...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Of course it feels nostalgic.
After all, this thing pinned to my chest is..."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...
Could it be you don't remember...?
choice_data_list: Huh! Um...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Racking my brain, I stare intently at her.
“This thing pinned to my chest”...?

Waah!
Buena-san, are you in your racing silks today?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: "So cute~! It looks wicked good on ya~!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking at Special Week as she called out to me,
I felt on the verge of remembering something.
choice_data_list: Right, I think she had something to do with it...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
That's right.
Even Spe-san wore this...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hm? What are you talking about?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I see...!
So that's what was going on.
choice_data_list: I'm pretty sure you had something to do with it, though.
I'm pretty sure you had something to do with it, though.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hmm, "myself"...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah!!
Could that be the clover brooch!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Told that, it finally clicked.
That's right... a long time ago, that brooch was something I gave to Buena Vista—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Look, look...!
I bought a cute pen case.
This pink and purple... hehehe.
choice_data_list: It looks like Special Week.
It looks like Special Week, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Right? Ehehe, and you know what else?
I bought the official Spe-san T-shirt too...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ah, this clover shape...!
It looks just like the one on Spe-san's racing silks.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Saying so, Buena Vista pointed
at a gold brooch
displayed in the accessories shop.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"So cute...! It's wonderful.
It's smaller than Spe-san's,
but it looks really easy to use, which is great!"
choice_data_list: Sounds good, it'll definitely suit you!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Um, I wonder how much it is...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Ngh...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
This looks a bit out of reach for my allowance.
Ehehe... let's go!
choice_data_list: (Buena... That's it!)

text_block_list.name: Elderly Man A
text_block_list.text: Oh my...! Don't think I've seen you delivering the paper before. Impressive for someone so young. Keep up the good work~.
choice_data_list: Yes! ...Hup, hup!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even though it was only short-term, waking up early every morning
and riding my bike around before school was tough. But thinking
of Buena Vista made it no hardship at all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And clutching the money I'd saved,
I bought the brooch they'd held for me,
then nervously ran off to meet her...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
“—So, what did you want to talk about?
Why are you being so formal all of a sudden?”
choice_data_list: This is... a present!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Huh...!
Is this... from back then...!?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Did you suddenly start that part-time job
because, could it be...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I confessed with a slight blush.
But it really was no big deal.
I just wanted to make Buena Vista happy...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you.
To be honest, I really, really wanted this...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Because they're my inspiration.
Even if it's just in appearance, getting closer makes me happy..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was intended only as a modest gift,
but at that moment, it reaffirmed something to me:
her dream was my dream too.
choice_data_list: Let's reach it someday—that breathtaking view!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...! Yeah...!
Let's make it come true, together...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—I remember it completely now!
That said, though it felt expensive back then, it's not high enough quality to attach to a racing outfit...
choice_data_list: Are you sure? Shouldn't it be something more impressive...?
Are you sure? Shouldn't it be something more impressive...?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Because to me,
it's a one-of-a-kind treasure.
It just has to be this one."
choice_data_list: Buena...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sorry, Spe-san!
Um, this was bought by my Trainer with money from a part-time job back when they were a student...
choice_data_list: Oh right, Buena wanted it— she looks up to you, after all
Oh right, Buena wanted it— she looks up to you, after all

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We accidentally left Special Week behind.
The two of them began explaining all at once...
choice_data_list: Buena, you were really touched back then too, weren't you?
Buena, you were really touched back then too, weren't you?
Special Week's motif is special, you know.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We accidentally left Special Week behind.
The two of them began explaining all at once...
choice_data_list: Buena, you were really touched back then too, weren't you?
Buena, you were really touched back then too, weren't you?
Special Week's motif is special, you know.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... And hearing that
made me get all teary-eyed.
choice_data_list: That's right.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wah...!
They were so happy they were moved to tears, huh.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
That's right.
Whenever I remember that time...
even now... ugh.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah-wah!
Buena-san...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"If you're that moved by it...
it makes me feel touched too...!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
That's right.
Because my dream all started with Spe-san.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'm the beginning... really?!
To have someone as amazing as you think of me that way, Buena-san...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe...
Does that mean I was able to show them a dream?
As the number one Umamusume in Japan...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Spe-san is Japan's number one...
No, to us, she is the world's best Umamusume.
